html:
When you are having your home or office windows tinted, it is important to ensure high-quality films are used and they are installed correctly. Below is info on why we are a great choice for home window tinting, the films available for office and house window tinting on the Gold Coast and the benefits of each.

Tint a Home has been providing tinting services in Australia for five decades and is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have a team of professionally trained window tinting Gold Coast based installers who will ensure films are applied correctly. Our films (exclusive to us) are Government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. We offer a lifetime warranty on home window tinting Gold Coast applications and up to 15 years for commercial applications. Here are the films available in our range

Films Available Through Our Window Tinting Gold Coast

  • Solar window films
  • Privacy films
  • Safety films
  • Security films
  • Decorative films

Benefits of House Window Tinting Gold Coast

In addition to daytime privacy without having to pull the curtains or blinds, here are some of the other benefits of Home tinting Gold Coast:

  • A reduction in heat during summer and a warmer house in winter (you’ll notice a positive difference to your power bills!)
  • Less glare in your home which also minimises reflections on screens
  • Protection from harmful UV rays
  • A safer and more secure home with a film that holds shattered glass together if broken
  • Premature fading of flooring and furnishings is minimised

Office Window Tinting Gold Coast

In addition to privacy, Office window tinting Gold Coastcreates a more consistent temperature inside your office. Window tinting keeps the heat out during warmer months and the heat in during cooler months (this also has a positive impact on power bills too).

Glare is reduced which minimises reflections on screens and your premises can be safer & secure with our safety or security film.

Our decorative film is popular with office spaces as you can customise designs to incorporate your branding and are great for creating private internal spaces.
